title: powerape 1.4.0
text: IV designs via control-function probit: ape_dgp_iv() specifies world endogenous focal variable – linear first stage continuous focal, probit first stage binary one, instruments friendly strength knob (iv_strength = share focal’s (latent) variance instruments explain), endogeneity = structural/first-stage error correlation. Estimation engine replicates Stata 18.5’s cfprobit exactly: two-step control function stacked method--moments standard errors (bootstrap; robust cluster flavors verified Stata ~1e-7, including convention details – observed score derivatives, generated regressors fixed instruments first-stage Jacobian, small-sample factors). estimand stays ASF-based APE/AIE, margins cfprobit targets control functions held fixed. IV interaction designs: binary exogenous moderator, main equation gains focal--moderator term, control function, control-function--moderator interaction (Stata’s interact() + mainonly()), first stage includes moderator instrument--moderator interactions – general IV requirement interaction models. Validated Stata’s exact syntax. estimator internals also cover fprobit poisson first stages, matching cfprobit’s fit exactly. fractional first stages found Stata’s margins internally inconsistent estimator (_remake_cfs.ado rebuilds control function binary-outcome branch, ignoring fractional value); powerape uses estimation-consistent generalized residuals, discrepancy reproduced 7 decimals validation battery. Robust standard errors standard routes: ape_power(), ape_curve(), ape_n() gain se = c("model", "robust") – heteroskedasticity-robust (HC0) sandwich matching sandwich::vcovHC(type = "HC0") exactly. Panel designs keep unit-clustered SEs IV designs stacked robust sandwich (warning explains se passed ). Validation: battery gains V10 (seven-case Stata equivalence table, fprobit attribution, engine consistency coverage, “IV price” anchor – zero endogeneity CF estimator’s SE exceeds exogenous estimator’s sqrt(1/iv_strength), 2SLS variance logic).

title: powerape 1.3.0
text: Panel AIE designs (binary x binary): ape_dgp_panel() gains moderator argument, set_aie() pins average interaction effect CRE panel world. anchors – baseline, two conditional--reference main-effect APEs, target AIE – defined average structural function (unit effects integrated exactly, Mundlak means held fixed), panel AIE population quantity cross-sectional AIE design targets. estimating model includes interaction’s Mundlak mean whenever product term time-varying (mean product product means); inference unit-clustered throughout, ape_robust(), ape_curve(), ape_n(), power_statement() work unchanged. Validation: ASF double difference matches Stata (probit .d##.m ... , vce(cluster id) + margins + lincom) printed digits fixed panel, clustered-SE gap fully attributed Stata’s observed-Hessian bread (reproduced 7 decimals); ginteff reproduces double difference model-based SE identical fit 1e-6; exact reduction inversion cross-sectional case rho = 0; estimator consistency nominal clustered-CI coverage true AIE. Battery gains V9. Continuous focal moderator pairs panel AIE designs yet supported (clean error); cross-sectional AIE keeps four type pairs. New vignette panel-designs: CRE workflow end end – panel knobs, units--observations accounting, panel-vs-cross-section comparison, rho robustness, panel AIE. README now covers panel route.

title: powerape 1.2.0
text: Panel designs: ape_dgp_panel() specifies correlated random effects (CRE) probit/logit world – Mundlak heterogeneity observed unit means, latent unit-effect share rho (xtprobit convention), cre_share heterogeneity-regressor correlation, per-variable within-unit persistence via pa_var(..., icc =) (icc = 1 gives unit-level, time-constant variables). Estimation engine pooled probit/logit Mundlak means unit-clustered standard errors; target remains ASF-based APE, pooled CRE estimator recovers even though coefficients attenuated. Sample-size arguments count units (clusters); contributes n_periods observations. Clustered delta-method inference: score-based cluster-robust sandwich matching R’s sandwich::vcovCL convention exactly (verified marginaleffects vcov = ~id); Stata’s vce(cluster) differs observed-Hessian bread (~0.3% validation example, attribution reproduced 7 decimals). warning issued 30 clusters. Validation: exact-enumeration reduction (-Mundlak case), Donner-Klar cluster design-effect anchor, clustered-CI coverage, documented “Mundlak insurance premium” (rho = 0 CRE estimator correctly less powerful cross-sectional analysis information). Battery gains V8. Panel scope release: parametric route, balanced panels, moderator (AIE) combination yet.
